statement.zh: **事件**：Lucky Thirteen 攻击（Lucky Thirteen Attack）。2013 年，研究团队公开 Lucky Thirteen 攻击：利用 TLS CBC 模式在 MAC 校验时的细微时间差，逐字节恢复明文。它说明即使协议使用标准密码原语，填充和 MAC 验证的实现顺序也能成为侧信道。
statement.en: **Event**: Lucky Thirteen Attack.It is registered under authentication and AEAD, dated 2013.

statement.zh: Lucky Thirteen 攻击的why见来源账本与正文其他节；该条目不以空段充数。
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in authentication and AEAD, not because of its name.
